key: must:I47c:Each label legible and with its stage in order
symptom: Each label legible and with its stage in order

whys.why: Why was 'Each label legible and with its stage in order' not met?
whys.because: The labels in the delivered videos are garbled, missing or on the wrong stage. They are not three clean words, one on each stage.
whys.evidence: s5.old.happy.I47c/grade.json: labels read 'Evapraton', 'Condesanian', 'Precipianton'/'Precaction!'. s5.old.dumper.I47c/grade.json: 'Evaporation' is not seen, 'Conddstion' appears at 1s during the evaporation stage, and extra text 'Ut ghh,' appears. The third (stupid) chat's reason is 'No labels'.

whys.why: Why are the labels garbled or misplaced?
whys.because: The video model drew the labels as pixels inside the picture. The assistant asked for them only in the text prompt, with timed captions for 0-3s, 3-6s and 6-10s.
whys.evidence: calls.jsonl in both old chats: one create_video_from_text call (model ltx-2.5, 480p, audio true). The style.prompt has 'caption ... reads exactly "Evaporation"... changes to exactly "Condensation"...'. No other edit or overlay call follows.

whys.why: Why did the assistant rely on in-prompt text rendering?
whys.because: The old tool list gives no tool to put exact text on top of a video. The assistant knew this and said so to the user. It shipped the result with a caveat and did not use another path.
whys.evidence: s5.old.happy.I47c calls.jsonl say text: 'The AI draws the captions as part of the picture... Magic Hour has no tool to put exact text on top of a video.' The dumper chat says the same: 'The AI draws the labels itself, so it can misspell them.'

whys.why: Why does in-picture text fail so badly here?
whys.because: A diffusion text-to-video model like ltx-2.5 at 480p cannot reliably spell multi-syllable words. It also cannot time captions to the second or keep them stable across frames. The voice-over script in the same prompt also leaks out as stray subtitle-like text ('Ut ghh,').
whys.evidence: dumper grade.json: subtitle-style garbled captions, labels on the wrong stage. happy grade.json: the last label changes mid-scene to 'Precaction!'. The prompts asked for exact spelling and 'no other text', and the model ignored both.

whys.why: Why does only the old build fail?
whys.because: The new build adds plan_request with an exact_words field. That field sends exact on-screen strings down a separate, controlled path, so the new chats did not hit this failure. The old build has nothing like it.
whys.evidence: tools-new.json: plan_request description 'exact_words is a list of strings, one for each line of text to show, exactly as the user wrote it'. tools-old.json has no plan_request. The symptom counts are old:3, new:0.

result.axiom: The text-to-video model (ltx-2.5, 480p) cannot render exact, legible, correctly timed words in the frame. The old build offers no deterministic text-overlay path, so prompt-only labels are the only option there, and they fail.
result.fix: In the old build, add (or route to) a text-overlay step: make the video with no on-screen text, then burn in the exact_words labels with set start/end times (for example 0-3s, 3-6s, 6-10s). This is what the new build's plan_request exact_words path supports. Never ask the generator to draw the exact labels.
